description.value: The Gateway is a small, family-run motel in Radium Hot Springs, situated just minutes from the entrance to Kootenay National Park and the world-famous Radium Hot Springs mineral pools. Guests enjoy panoramic views of the Columbia Valley from sunny balconies, and the landscaped grounds include BBQ areas, fire pits, and a rustic barrel outdoor sauna. The surrounding area offers mountain biking, hiking, white-water rafting, and year-round wildlife watching — including a resident herd of over 200 bighorn sheep that roam the village.

address.value: 4992 Hwy 93, Radium Hot Springs, British Columbia, V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed property information. Free Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM (internet_access=wlan) and multiple website passages ('FREE Wi-Fi', 'wireless Internet access'). A complimentary continental breakfast is confirmed on the front page and rooms page, served at the affiliated Screamers Ice Cream Cafe. No mention of bicycle storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or e-bike charging appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null. Luggage storage is confirmed in the policies page for early-arriving guests.
concerns: Minor address discrepancy: OSM lists 'Banff-Windermere Parkway' while the website uses 'Hwy 93' — these refer to the same road; website version used as it includes full postal address.
OSM alt_name is 'The Gateway Motel' but the business presents itself simply as 'The Gateway' on all website pages; no substantive issue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating, publicly accessible motel in a popular cycling gateway town adjacent to Kootenay National Park. Actively maintained website with current booking functionality and 2026 copyright.
enrichment_extras.notes: The motel explicitly markets itself as motorcycle-friendly but makes no mention of bicycle-specific services or storage. The affiliated Screamers Ice Cream Cafe provides the included breakfast and is located off-property at 7518 Main Street East.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Complimentary continental breakfast included with stay, served at the affiliated Screamers Ice Cream Cafe at 7518 Main Street East. Guests also receive 10% off all other purchases at that cafe

Luggage storage.detail: Policies page states: 'If you arrive earlier then we will be pleased to store your luggage until your room is ready.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'restaurants... are only minutes away' from the property in Radium Hot Springs village
